reasoning: ICICI Bank remains uninitiated despite being India's largest private sector bank by market cap and a pure play on India's structural growth story. With Indian banks outperforming EM peers and ICICI's digital transformation driving record ROEs above 18%, this is the optimal entry point for comprehensive coverage. The recent Jindal Power financing news underscores ICICI's role in India's infrastructure buildout.
title: ICICI Bank: India's Digital Banking Champion at the Center of a $5 Trillion Economy
angle: Consensus views ICICI as a 'safe' EM bank play, but underappreciates the operating leverage embedded in its digital-first strategy — 95%+ of retail transactions now digital, cost-to-income trending toward 38%, and a credit card/payments business growing 25%+ annually. Liria sees ICICI not as a traditional bank but as a fintech platform with a banking license, trading at just 2.8x book while delivering fintech-like growth metrics.
